documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) Of The Company For The Second Quarter (Q2) And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Stylam Industries Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 24, 2026, discussing financial results, capacity expansion timelines, and domestic market restructuring. Management noted that the new laminate plant is undergoing dry runs with commercial production scheduled for September 1, 2026, and expects the plant to generate between INR250 crores and INR300 crores in revenue during its first year at a 30% capacity utilization. The company also commented on raw material prices, stable operating margins, and ongoing efforts to expand its domestic presence through new distribution networks and team restructuring. Stylam Industries reported its Q1 FY27 performance with a 15% revenue increase compared to the same period last year and highlighted its debt-free status. The company operates manufacturing facilities with an annual capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets and is progressing on a new greenfield manufacturing plant in Panchkula, Haryana.

guidance.claim: Management expects similar margin profiles of 19% to 20% plus even after the new capex commences.
guidance.quote: So, we can expect the similar kind of margins 19%, 20% plus.

guidance.claim: The company expects 20% to 30% capacity utilization for the new plant in its first year.
guidance.quote: Plus, what we are looking at for the first year, maybe 20% to 30% plus capacity utilization for the new plant.

guidance.claim: Management targets around INR250 crores to INR300 crores in revenue from the third plant in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: I think based on the value of what you were saying, around INR250 crores to INR300 crores, it would be easily achieved from the third plant.

guidance.claim: Stylam expressed confidence in achieving its financial guidance.
guidance.quote: Stylam is confident in achieving its financial guidance, indicating sustained momentum for growth.

guidance.claim: The management expects to generate INR300 crores to INR400 crores in turnover from the new plant in the next 3 quarters.
guidance.quote: But we are quite hopeful that we can get INR300 crores, INR400 crores turnover from this plant in the next 3 quarters.

guidance.claim: For the financial year, the company targets INR250 crores to INR300 crores from the new plant.
guidance.quote: For this financial year, I think we will target INR250 crores to INR300 crores from that particular plant.

guidance.claim: Management stated that revenue will grow by 20% to 25% compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: We cannot, it will be definitely 20%, 25% increase than the previous.

demand_outlook.claim: US import tariffs on laminates remain at 10% following recent news updates.
demand_outlook.quote: So, I think it would be 10% only right now going forward, but the today's today morning news came, we have to recheck it once.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe, the APAC region, and the Middle East are performing positively for export markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Further ahead I think APAC region and Middle East. So, I think to be honest it's going positive for us in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to meeting increasing market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Dry run trials for the new plant are already underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Dry run, dry run trial is already going on.

capex_expansion.claim: Stylam is setting up a new greenfield manufacturing facility as its third laminate plant adjacent to the existing facility in Manak Tabra.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam Industries is strengthening its leadership position with commissioning of new green-field manufacturing facility, our third laminate plant, strategically located next to our existing facility at Manak Tabra in Panchkula, Haryana

capex_expansion.claim: The groundwork for the new plant is underway to enhance the ability to meet rising global demand.
capex_expansion.quote: The groundwork for the new plant is underway, enhancing our ability to meet rising global demand with greater speed and scale.

capex_expansion.claim: The construction of the third greenfield laminate plant in Manak Tabra is progressing towards commercial production.
capex_expansion.quote: You mentioned that the construction of the third greenfield laminate plant in Manak Tabra is progressing well in the PPT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has incurred a total capex of INR334 crores for the new plant.
capex_expansion.quote: We have at this moment done the capex of INR334 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The margin improvement was driven by operational efficiency and higher sales volume rather than inventory gains.
margins_costs.quote: No, no inventory gain. nothing. It is our efficiency and it is our more utilization and if you go for sales figures it is increased. So, when sales increase, the expenses automatically reduce.

margins_costs.claim: Current phenol prices are approximately USD1,400 per ton, while melamine is around USD1,000 to USD1,100 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: Right now, the phenol prices are approximately around USD1,400 per ton. Melamine is around USD1,000 to USD1,100.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that domestic market losses have been stopped and reduced across recent quarters.
margins_costs.quote: I think the losses have been reduced, that is the only thing which might be an improvement in the margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company improved net gross margins by enhancing the share of value-added products.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced the share of value-added products in the product mix, expanded the product range, and improved net gross margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a gross margin of 49% in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: I think it was 49% in the fourth quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company has implemented price increases of 3% to 5% with customers.
margins_costs.quote: We already increased 3% to 5% to our customers, almost every manufacturer.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam operates an annual laminate production capacity of approximately 20 million sheets.
orders_capacity.quote: Annual production capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam sold 3.17 million sheets during Q1 FY27 comprising 1.10 million domestic and 2.07 million export sheets.
orders_capacity.quote: Company has sold 3.17 Mn Sheets during the Q1 FY27 (Domestic - 1.10 Mn & Export 2.07 Mn) as compared to 3.27 Mn Sheets in Q4 FY26 (Domestic - 1.06 Mn & Export 2.21 Mn).

orders_capacity.claim: The laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. And one more, sir, on the capacity utilization, the laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam became a completely debt-free company and maintained this status even after establishing a new plant.
capital_allocation.quote: Became a net debt-free company and maintained this status, even after establishing a new plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistics represents a significant problem globally, including for the Middle East market.
risks_headwinds.quote: In fact, for the entire world right now logistics is a very big problem, but that is a part of the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that commodity and raw material prices have increased due to the situation in the Middle East market.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, the things, the raw material commodity prices have increased for each and every company, not only laminates, we talk about any company, any product due to this, all the supply are coming from Middle East market.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that visible results from domestic market restructuring will appear from Q3 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And you will definitely see the results from Quarter 3. I won't even say Quarter 2, but you will see the results from Quarter 3 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production of the new plant will commence by September 1, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the new plant to commence commercial production by the middle of July or end of June.
management_commitments.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates achieving 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And that is why what we were saying that the ramp-ups definitely in the next 2 years, we will be able to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
